rationale: Internally coherent and correctly signed, but it is the third re-weighting of the same EBITDA-yield-plus-net-repurchase core by a liquidity/maturity rank (Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion, Cash-Adjusted Maturity Discretion), and MIN of two highly correlated balance-sheet ranks is unlikely to add information beyond the already-tested net-current-debt version.

This is a mechanical mash-up of two archived signals (Liquidity-Capped Repurchase Credit and Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion) and is structurally identical to Solvency-Weighted Liquidity Repurchase with dlc/at swapped for lt/at, so it is a cosmetic variant rather than a new mechanism.

target_name: Operating Value with Organic Equity Accretion
rationale: The construction is clean and correctly signed, but it is Organic Book Accretion Value with only the value leg swapped from B/M to EBITDA yield, and the second leg (clean-surplus retained-earnings growth net of external equity) is close to the well-known net-share-issuance/retained-earnings anomalies, so the incremental content is thin.

Expression matches the hypothesis (positive-part repurchases gated on sales growth, negative-part issuance gated on sales contraction), but it is literally Fundamentally Validated Equity Action with ceq/mktcap replaced by ebitda/mktcap — a single-leg substitution already performed repeatedly across the archive.

A well-motivated binary-to-continuous refinement of Debt-Service-Covered Financing whose direction matches the hypothesis, though the reviewer should note that IND_RANK((ebitda-dlc)/at) largely blends profitability with the already-tested current-debt rank, so any gain may be a repackaged profitability tilt.

Since che is already a component of at, dlc/(at+che) is a near-monotone rescaling of dlc/at for the vast majority of firms, making this an economically arbitrary denominator change that will reproduce the archived Maturity-Weighted Financing Discretion signal almost exactly.
